supporting_observations.claim: Between 13:41:30 and 14:06:11 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 made a series of connections to the explicit proxy at roughly five-minute intervals. The Zeek records show similar traffic volumes across these connections.

At 14:10:59 UTC, just after the stated collection-outage window, the proxy recorded a connection to the approved ChartMate update domain; endpoint records attribute the corresponding proxy connection to the approved cmupdate.exe path.
Before the alert interval, WS-BCARTER-01 obtained Kerberos tickets for lucy.park and WS-LPARK-01, and WS-LPARK-01 recorded a successful network logon for lucy.park from WS-BCARTER-01.
At 13:58:59 UTC, WS-BCARTER-01 connected to DC-HD-01 over SMB, and the domain controller recorded an ANONYMOUS LOGON network logon for that connection.
At 14:14:56 UTC, after the alert interval, Cisco AnyConnect's UI was launched on WS-BCARTER-01 and its Cisco-signed vpnapi.dll was loaded. These records do not show that a VPN connection was made.

known_telemetry_limitations: Winsec and Sysmon collection for WS-BCARTER-01 was unavailable from 13:30:00 to 14:10:00 UTC, so process attribution for the periodic connections during that interval is missing.
Proxy collection was unavailable from 13:30:00 to 14:10:00 UTC, so the destination hostnames and request details for the periodic connections in that interval are not present.
Zeek connection records are available for the interval, but the supplied records identify the proxy connection rather than the ultimate HTTPS destination.
claims_not_established: Whether the periodic connections during the collection outage were all to update.chartmate-imaging.com or to another destination.
Whether lucy.park's network logon from WS-BCARTER-01 was authorized or what activity followed it.
What SMB resource or operation was involved in the connection to DC-HD-01, and whether the anonymous logon represents malicious activity.
Whether Cisco AnyConnect established a VPN connection; the available records show only UI execution and a signed DLL load.
Whether data was exfiltrated or malicious code executed during the review window.
additional_evidence_needed: Recover or obtain proxy logs for 13:30:00–14:10:00 UTC and identify the destination hostnames, requests, and any associated tunnel details.
Obtain endpoint process and network telemetry for WS-BCARTER-01 covering the same interval, including process-to-connection attribution.
Verify with the relevant users or administrative records whether lucy.park's logon from WS-BCARTER-01 and the SMB activity were expected.
Check VPN client configuration and connection logs to determine whether AnyConnect connected and whether its presence is authorized.
Review available file-access and authentication records for the SMB connection and subsequent activity on DC-HD-01 and WS-LPARK-01.
